# Lua API reference

<!-- Generated by crates/pi-rs-host/tests/api_reference.rs. Do not edit by hand. -->
<!-- Regenerate: PI_RS_WRITE_API_REFERENCE=1 cargo test -p pi-rs-host --test api_reference -->

Every member below was walked out of the live `pi` table an ordinary package
receives, and every handle method was read out of its `impl UserData` block in
`crates/pi-rs-host/src`. Names, kinds, and constant values are generated; only the
sentences are written by hand, and a member with no sentence — or a sentence with
no member — fails `cargo test -p pi-rs-host --test api_reference`. Embedded and
file-backed packages receive the same table, so nothing here is provenance-specific.

This is the inventory. `docs/lua-extension-api.md` explains the mechanisms and
their rules; `docs/lua-coding-spine.md` explains the coding-spine event and display
contracts.

Surface: 8 modules, 104 members, 10 handles, 35 handle methods.

## Modules

Each top-level namespace holds exactly one version table, so a breaking change
ships beside its predecessor rather than replacing it.

### `pi.auth.v1`

Credential storage, resolution, and subscription login at file locations the caller passes in.

| Member | Kind | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `api_version` | `1` | Contract version of this module; a breaking change ships as `v2` beside it. |
| `default_login_timeout_ms` | `900000` | `options.timeout_ms` used when a login supplies none. |
| `login` | function | `login(provider, callbacks[, options]) -> credentials` — Runs one subscription OAuth flow and returns the credential row instead of storing it; every user-visible step is a Lua callback. |
| `max_login_models` | `128` | Most catalog ids `options.model_ids` may enable after a login. |
| `max_login_timeout_ms` | `3600000` | Largest accepted `options.timeout_ms`. |
| `max_providers` | `256` | Most stored providers one `snapshot()` reports. |
| `max_secret_bytes` | `65536` | Largest stored or resolved secret, and the bound on pasted login codes and prompt answers. |
| `providers` | function | `providers() -> rows` — Subscription identities that can refresh a stored OAuth row (`id`, `name`, `uses_callback_server`), in registry order. |
| `store` | function | `store{canonical=[, legacy=]} -> CredentialStore` — Opens a credential store; `canonical` is the only file ever written and `legacy` is a read-only fallback used only while `canonical` is absent. |

### `pi.effects.v1`

Bounded filesystem, path, environment, process, timer, and cancellation effects.

| Member | Kind | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `api_version` | `1` | Contract version of this module. |
| `cancellation` | table | Standalone abort signals a package can hand to the effects it wants to cancel itself. |
| `env` | table | Immutable snapshot of the process environment taken when the host started; there is no write path. |
| `fs` | table | Bounded filesystem effects; every path is supplied by the caller. |
| `path` | table | Pure POSIX path arithmetic: it computes locations and never chooses one. |
| `process` | table | Bounded subprocess execution. |
| `timer` | table | Scope-owned timers. |

### `pi.kernel.v1`

The package transaction: roots, declarations, queued actions and effects, modules, immutable handles, and scoped resources.

| Member | Kind | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | function | `action(kind[, payload])` — Queues one action; the queue publishes only after the dispatch succeeds. |
| `api_version` | `1` | Contract version of this module. |
| `cancellation` | function | `cancellation() -> Cancellation` — Token of the innermost running dispatch. |
| `declare` | function | `declare(kind, definition)` — The one declaration path for every declared kind, including providers, tools, and themes. |
| `effect` | function | `effect(kind[, payload])` — Queues one effect request alongside the actions of the same dispatch. |
| `module` | table | Exact `name@version` module registry with an explicit reload lifecycle. |
| `read_handle` | function | `read_handle(value) -> ReadHandle` — Freezes a value behind a generation-stamped read handle. |
| `registered` | function | `registered(kind) -> definitions` — Reads declarations of one kind back in declaration order. |
| `resource` | function | `resource(disposer) -> Resource` — Registers a disposer on the current scope, so cleanup runs at package disposal rather than at Lua garbage collection. |
| `root` | function | `root(definition)` — Registers one root; `pi.roots.v1.register` is the facade over it. |
| `roots` | function | `roots([kind]) -> rows` — Root registrations as data — `kind`, `id`, `source`, `priority`, `active`, `selected` — never the `dispatch` function. |
| `select_root` | function | `select_root(kind[, id])` — Resolves one kind to one registration id regardless of priority; omitting `id` clears the selection. |

#### `pi.kernel.v1.module`

| Member | Kind | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `define` | function | `define(definition)` — Defines one exact identity; a duplicate identity is refused, so there stays one declaration path. |
| `list` | function | `list() -> rows` — `name`, `version`, `source`, and `state` (`defined` or `loaded`) in definition order. |
| `remove` | function | `remove(name, version) -> boolean` — Drops the declaration and prunes the order index; `remove` then `define` is how a live identity is replaced. |
| `require` | function | `require(name, version) -> value` — Resolves one exact identity, running its factory once. |
| `reset` | function | `reset(name, version) -> boolean` — Drops only the cached value, so the next `require` re-runs the same factory. |

Batched terminal input, the retained display, and the Unicode cell measurement a package lays out with.

## Handles

Handles are values the modules above return. They are not reachable from the `pi`
table and carry no members beyond these. Sections follow the reading order of the
modules that hand them out; methods follow their `impl UserData` block.

### `Display`

Returned by `pi.terminal.v1.display([limits])`.

| Method | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| `submit` | `submit(batch) -> {revision, painted_cells, placed_images}` — Submits one complete versioned tree and presents the difference; nothing crosses per cell. |
| `revision` | `revision() -> number` — Revision of the retained tree, unchanged when a submission changes nothing. |
| `reset_presentation` | `reset_presentation()` — Forgets what the terminal is believed to show, so the next submit repaints everything. |

### `InputBuffer`

Returned by `pi.terminal.v1.input_buffer()`.

| Method | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| `feed` | `feed(data) -> events` — Decodes one chunk into complete input events. |
| `flush` | `flush() -> events` — Decodes whatever is buffered, resolving a pending ambiguous prefix. |
| `clear` | `clear()` — Drops buffered bytes. |
| `buffer` | `buffer() -> data` — The undecoded bytes still held. |

### `RecordStore`

Returned by `pi.records.v1.create` and `pi.records.v1.open`; every open store is a scope resource of its package.

| Method | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| `path` | `path() -> path` — On-disk location of this store. |
| `record_count` | `record_count() -> number` — Records appended so far. |
| `append` | `append(value[, options]) -> sequence` — Appends one opaque record and returns its sequence number. |
| `cursor` | `cursor() -> RecordCursor` — Opens a bounded reader over this store. |
| `copy` | `copy{directory=, name=[, record_count=]} -> path` — Atomic prefix snapshot of this store at another destination. |
| `close` | `close()` — Closes the file and releases the lock without waiting for disposal. |
| `closed` | `closed() -> boolean` — Whether this store has already been closed. |

### `RecordCursor`

Returned by `RecordStore:cursor()`.

| Method | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| `next_sequence` | `next_sequence() -> number` — Sequence this cursor will read next. |
| `next` | `next([{max_records=, max_bytes=, cancellation=}]) -> window` — One bounded window carrying `records`, `start_sequence`, `next_sequence`, `encoded_bytes`, and `done`. |

### `Package`

Returned by `pi.packages.v1.load`.

| Method | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| `source` | `source() -> source` — Provenance string of the loaded package. |
| `scope` | `scope() -> number` — Scope that owns the loaded package's registrations. |
| `disposed` | `disposed() -> boolean` — Whether this package has already been disposed. |
| `dispose` | `dispose()` — Disposes the loaded package and, transitively, everything it composed. |

### `CredentialStore`

Returned by `pi.auth.v1.store`; it owns no operating-system resource between calls.

| Method | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| `snapshot` | `snapshot() -> {source, providers}` — Provenance (`canonical`, `legacy`, or `absent`) and stored provider names; never a secret. |
| `describe` | `describe(provider) -> description\|nil` — `kind` plus, for an OAuth row, `expires`, `expired`, and the provider-defined `extra_fields` names; never a secret. |
| `set_api_key` | `set_api_key(provider, value)` — Stores an api-key expression; the first write promotes storage to `canonical` and migrates legacy rows forward. |
| `set_oauth` | `set_oauth(provider, credentials)` — Stores an OAuth row, preserving every provider-defined extra field verbatim. |
| `remove` | `remove(provider)` — Removes one stored row. |
| `resolve` | `resolve(provider) -> {api_key, refreshed}\|nil` — The only member that yields a secret: it expands a stored expression and refreshes an expired OAuth row under the same lock. |

| --- | --- |
| `is_cancelled` | `is_cancelled() -> boolean` — Whether the owning dispatch has been cancelled. |
| `wait` | `wait()` — Waits until the owning dispatch is cancelled. |

Returned by `pi.effects.v1.cancellation.new()` and accepted by the effects that can be cancelled.

| --- | --- |
